title: Pelican Lakes – June 23rd, 2013
author: madwire
excerpt: Lovely venue at Pelican Lakes and even on a Sunday this wedding kept on rockin’ until 10pm. JAMMIN DJ’s made a special day even more memorable by rockin’ the place to the foundation. Everyone was cuttin’ a rug and tearin’ it up! Sucessful… that would be an understatement! DJ Herb
